name: 08812 · Dunellen, NJ
findings: ZIP 08812 (Dunellen) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08812 (Dunellen) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
